Applied Artificial Intelligence (BA in Interdisciplinary Studies)

The curriculum for the Major in Applied Artificial Intelligence requires 30 credit hours to complete. A minimum of 120 credits are required to fulfill all degree requirements; information on other degree requirements can be found in the catalog section “Requirements for Degrees”.
